terminal_rule: Use pre-command virtual progress s. Latch terminal iff s >= max(start of final nonzero edge, L-2m). Then command the actual goal forever. At most one switch. No parameter search.
unchanged: All stage5a vehicle/kinematic/safety/arrival/time settings; stage5ae LOS progress and normal guidance. No speed adaptation, new steering or path processing.
development: All306 stage5ae solved tasks, raw/shortcut; at most612 new corrected conditions. Legacy and old LOS referenced in place. Fixed pilot: first2 lexicographic solved job_ids per family, both processing forms,12 conditions reused in full run.
gate_policy: Analytic and safety acceptance, pilot and all development, parameter freeze commit, then prospective geometry acceptance and18 resource tasks, full216 reusing all finished tasks. No success-rate threshold.
nontrivial_geometry: All new nominal-body direct start-goal lines must be blocked and declared geometric witnesses valid. Negative margin corridor separately certified. Never change geometry after viewing planner/controller outcomes; retain ceiling effects if they occur.
statistics: Three denominators, every registered task retained. Whole-map bootstrap2000, RNG65988, paired gains/losses. Maps, not seeds, are clusters; intervals exploratory.
safety: Re-certify every new interval with unchanged curved-motion enclosure; independent RK4 first/middle/last and point-box/Lipschitz diagnostics for first safety failures. Pre-terminal state/control/safety fields must equal frozen LOS within1e-12; drift is a gate failure.
storage: Exclusive records outside repository; legacy traces referenced, identical or exactly matched prefix traces reused. No extra file checksums. Process lock acquired before heavy work.
stop: Stop on technical error, drift, unsafe acceptance, unresolved resource guard or concurrency collision. Preserve partial evidence. Final A/B/C baseline decision, stop for researcher and ChatGPT review.
